description.narrative: Enhancing subnational authorities capacities to engage in holistic, area-based planning and consider different scenarios that respond to the needs of host, refugee and IDP populations, including through increasingly responsive service delivery

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).
UNDP as the Implementing Partner will comply with the policies, procedures and practices of the United Nations Security Management System (UNSMS.)

All target were fully reached by the end of 2021.

Some unspent funds remained and UN-Habitat submitted a request for a time extension (until April 30, 2022) to carry on some additional WASH activities/interventions and utilize the unspent balances in a way that maximizes impact of the programme. In 2022, the rehabilitation and extension of the storm water network in the low-lying area of Al-Matahin that was affected by seasonal flash floods was completed. Over 1,034 beneficiaries (119 housing units, 198 families, 459 males, 575 females) benefited from this WASH intervention. UN-Habitat also completed the rehabilitation and replacement of potable water network in the Maghrib area, adjacent to Al Matahin, in west Mosul. This intervention benefited over 1,109 inhabitants (147 housing unit, 199 families, 524 males, 585 females) by enhancing the quality of water in the targeted area, reducing water waste resulting from cracks in the networks and the time required for the maintenance process, providing water pressure balance for the network and saving budgets that are continuously spent on maintenance work in this area. Additional 400 WASH/cleaning kits were distributed to targeted beneficiary families in selected vulnerable neighborhoods of Mosul. This initiative was designed to help people improve cleaning and hygiene practices. The kits included a double-sided leaflet promoting water-saving strategies and practicing hygiene with less water, to counter the ongoing water scarcity and drought in Iraq.
